title: Exact certificate for the dimension-15 thirteen-facet theorem

claims.statement: Every convex polytope of dimension at least 15 has a three-face with at most 13 facets.
claims.logical_role: The paper combines its human proofs of row nonnegativity with the exact certificate identity.

claims.statement: The recorded positive combination of 987 admissible rows equals minus the normalization functional modulo the generalized Dehn--Sommerville relations.
claims.logical_role: The certificate supplies compact row reconstruction data and a primitive integer form of every exact multiplier.

artifacts.role: Primitive integer certificate containing named factor rows, positive inequality coefficients, and the generalized Dehn--Sommerville lift.

producer.provenance: Losslessly schema-translated and primitively normalized from the certificate exported by external run R20260719-CSK3-T56-Q14-CERT-EXPORT-049 (source SHA-256 787d8ba49c1b30617f114cd8a7cbaa683a4d042c318aa4100a3a3c0d223f97d2): rational multipliers were converted to common-denominator integer coefficients, legacy factor addresses were replaced by stable names resolving to the same catalogue entries, and discovery-only metadata was omitted. The historical discovery pipeline is not included.

environment.description: Python 3.10 or newer using only the standard library; single-process verification with expected memory below 2 GiB; no TeX installation required.
